title: Read, Route, Relieve
purpose: Make the first post-morph scar-flow cell playable without combat or gate logic.

stages.instruction: Pulse the memory fleck; let the scar show what it is holding.
Pulse the resonant path thread; let signal draw a safer route.
Move with the pressure current; let the fold breathe.
Do not consume the clot. Pulse it only after the path is readable.

nextIfCompleted: HC-002J Scar-Flow Exit Readiness / Second Morph Planning
meaning: The player learns that scar matter is not solved by eating it; it is read, routed, relieved, and respected.
